title: Hook-first: 91-shard mega-drop into core loop, worker hire, and 89-gold rush

clips.why: Opens on hauling and dumping a towering 91-shard stack into the market bin.
Shows virtual joystick movement and mining green shards onto the character's back.
Carries 35 shards across the courtyard and stocks the market bin for customers.
Collects 46 earned gold bars from the market carpet.
Spends gold on the 10-gold pad to hire the first automated miner.
Collects a huge stack of 89 gold bars from the blue-and-gold market carpet.
Upgrades the worker pad at 40 gold to hire a second miner.
